[[Forgotten Guardian]]s are protecting the teleporters which transport players from [[the Arid Sea]] to [[Crystal Overlook]] and vice versa.

==Locations==
*[[Prophecies]]
**[[Crystal Desert]]
***{{NPC location|The Arid Sea}}

*[[Nightfall]]
**[[The Desolation]]
***{{NPC location|Crystal Overlook}}

==Dialogue==
In the Arid Sea:
:''"This portal leads to the Desolation, a deadly wasteland shrouded in poisonous sulfur mists. You do not have the means to survive in such a place so I cannot grant you passage."''
:{{ask|gold}} '''I want to travel to the Desolation of [[Elona]].''' (If requirements are met.)
::''"This portal will take you to Crystal Overlook, inside the Desolation in the north of Elona. I can sense your command over the [[junundu]], a very rare talent indeed these days. As you will have no problems traversing the sulfurous wastes, you may travel there if you wish."''
::{{yes|ingame}} '''We are ready.''' (Sent to Crystal Overlook.)
::{{no|ingame}} '''We are not ready yet.'''
:{{no}} '''I'll be on my way.'''

In Crystal Overlook:
:''"This portal leads to the sacred Crystal Desert of [[Tyria]]. I cannot allow you to pass unless you are familiar with its dangers."''
:{{ask|gold}} '''I want to travel to the Crystal Desert of Tyria.''' (If requirements are met.)
::''"I sense you have a purpose in the Crystal Desert. This portal will lead you to the Arid Sea. Are you ready to travel there?"''
::{{yes|ingame}} '''We are ready.''' (Sent to the Arid Sea.)
::{{no|ingame}} '''We are not ready yet.'''
:{{no}} '''I'll be on my way.'''

==Notes==
*In either way, you need to have completed the [[Gate of Desolation]] in Nightfall and [[Sanctum Cay]] in Prophecies to travel with them.
*This [[NPC]] enables [[Vanquisher|vanquishing]] the whole Crystal Desert with a [[party]] of 8. Start from [[The Mouth of Torment]], and take the western portal. Through the [[Crystal Overlook]], get to [[the Arid Sea]], [[Vulture Drifts]], [[Prophet's Path]], [[Salt Flats]], [[Diviner's Ascent]], [[Skyward Reach]], and [[the Scar]].
